# Exact visible-only preparation can require infinite mean even in four rapidly mixing states

29 October 2026. Astra P1, existing record-geometry complementary role.
Self-contained constructive obstruction; no priority claim.

## 1. Consequence

There is no universal visible-only stopping rule that exactly prepares a
nontrivial visible reweighting of the full microscopic law, from one warranted
stationary specimen, with finite expected native-call count, even for the
explicit four-state family below. Every native kernel is strictly positive,
reversible for the same known uniform microscopic law, and has a common
Doeblin constant. The impossibility is not a slow-mixing lower bound, a
conserved-sector mismatch, or uncertainty about the stationary masses.

More precisely, any one rule that is almost surely finite and exactly correct
for every member of this family has infinite expected length on the family's
independent-visible-bit sources. These sources have completely ordinary iid
visible records; their hidden bit still evolves.

The result concerns one unknown actual operation and a noninvasive visible
bit. It does not forbid finite-mean exact preparation with independent fresh
baseline trials, additional microscopic observations, a known kernel, or a
stronger structural interface. It also does not imply inefficient finite-
tolerance preparation. Section 7 gives a logarithmic-in-tolerance upper bound
for this same uniformly mixing family.

## 2. Interface and explicit family

The full microscopic state is x=(y,h) in {−1,+1}². Only y is observed. Let
mu be uniform on all four states, so the visible baseline mass is exactly
known to be one half. For 0<lambda<1/2, let

    P_0,lambda((y,h),(y',h')) = (1+lambda h h')/4.

This independently refreshes y to a fair sign at every call and evolves h
with one-step correlation lambda. Let S be the deterministic swap

    S(y,h)=(h,y),

and for 0<=delta<=1/4 define the actual native call

    P_delta,lambda=(1−delta)P_0,lambda+delta S.        (1)

The decomposition is a description of the hidden source. The controller is
not told which part occurred and cannot choose the parts separately.

Both P_0,lambda and S are symmetric stochastic matrices. Thus every (1) is
mu-reversible and has the same full stationary baseline. Every matrix entry
is at least

# A preparation hierarchy under rapid microscopic mixing

29 October 2026. Astra P1 root construction. This combines the independently
developed four-state obstruction with two explicit changes of information or
precision. The hard-deadline argument is a new application of the preserved
signed-continuation control principle, not a claim to have invented polynomial
continuation. The finite-mean escape is ordinary target-and-hit feedback.

## 1. The physical service and its interface

The entire microscopic state of this mathematical receiver is
`X=(Y,H) in {-1,+1}^2`. The warranted baseline is uniform, `mu(x)=1/4`.
One actual native call has kernel

\[
 P_{\delta,\lambda}=(1-\delta)P_{0,\lambda}+\delta S,
 \qquad
 P_{0,\lambda}((y,h),(y',h'))={1+\lambda hh'\over4},
 \qquad S(y,h)=(h,y),
\]

where `0 <= delta <= 1/4` and `0 < lambda < 1/2`. The controller does not know
these parameters. It cannot select the mixture component, inspect the native
random seed, reset the specimen, or retain a physical copy. Every call is the
same combined operation. Native call count is the cost unit; a physical-time
claim additionally needs actual durations and sensing/control costs.

All these kernels are symmetric and preserve `mu`. Every entry is at least
`c=3/32`, so every one has the common minorization

\[
 P_{\delta,\lambda}(x,\cdot)\ \ge {3\over8}\mu(\cdot).
\]

This is a uniformly rapidly mixing, irreducible finite-state family. No frozen
sector or arbitrarily small spectral gap supplies the obstruction below.
The full microscopic model and this minorization are structural promises of
the receiver; a finite label trace does not establish them.

The desired preparation is the actual endpoint distribution

\[
 \nu(y,h)={1+ay\over4},\qquad 0<|a|<1.
\]

A weaker observable service, sufficient for both impossibility results, asks
only for

\[
 \mathbb E Y_\tau=a,\qquad
 \mathbb E Y_{\tau+1}=0,                                      \tag{1}
\]

where the second label follows one fresh native call after completion. Indeed
`P Y=delta H`, and `nu H=0`. The second native call is a real possible future
experiment. The controller is not asked to prepare an independent copy of its
own retained history.

# Root receiving review of the constructive complements

29 October 2026. Actual internal mathematical review. This does not establish
historical priority, experimental performance or apparatus availability.
Proof inputs are pinned in ROOT_RECEIVING_INPUTS.json and copied byte-for-byte
in root_reviewed_versions/. Older accepted proofs and reviews are unchanged.

## Four-state universal preparation obstruction: accepted

Read the complete proof at SHA256
`e99e3781a21195d50ffe790dee9ca37183ca267731552d2e1b728ccbe3786cc8`,
read its complete rational checker, and independently reran it. Checker SHA:
`ca1579d04168fa16d5b3d2c8b8883dbcdaf4790de2708df2c6424708c5b358b7`.
Reproduced result SHA:
`1132e3697bc5b244f9b92e8821e4eb2d8d94f9e45ea3e6a2a563ff7b1cecd80f`.

Conditional on the complete mixture-selector sequence, the reference visible
record is iid: its first swap value is the independent fair pre-swap hidden
bit, and later swap positions receive fresh reference signs. Thus the reference
record and its stopping time are independent of the selectors. Actual and
reference histories agree until a second swap. If E tau is finite, the chance
of two swaps before the reference stop is o(delta), by domination with tau.
No second moment or analytic unbounded stopped likelihood is assumed.

On an exactly-one-swap path, the deposited visible sign has terminal hidden
mean lambda^(tau-s)Y_(s-1). Zero-swap paths have conditional hidden mean zero.
The resulting absolutely summable response coefficients are independent of
lambda at the iid-visible source. Exactness throughout the actual lambda
interval makes them vanish; optional sampling makes their sum -a. The
contradiction applies to arbitrary randomized causal stopping, including an
in-protocol calibration prefix. External parameter-dependent advice changes
the interface. Positive-delta stopping only needs to be almost surely finite.

The family has all entries at least 3/32. It is a uniformly mixing partial-
observation/universality obstruction, not a small-gap or sector example.
Since P Y=delta H, the completion-label mean and one later native-label mean
already state the failed service without demanding a hidden measurement.

The independent run passed 16 kernel fixtures, all 676 deterministic visible
stopping trees through three calls, and 2,028 exact first-order identities.
